results.title: STream3R: Scalable Sequential 3D Reconstruction with Causal Transformer
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes a decoder-only Transformer formulation for pointmap prediction that processes image sequences with causal attention for streaming 3D reconstruction and online 3D perception.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; title, keywords, and abstract directly match streaming/online point-map and 3D reconstruction scope.

results.title: Streaming Visual Geometry Transformer
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview presents a streaming visual geometry transformer using causal temporal attention and cached historical keys/values as implicit memory for online, low-latency, long-term 3D reconstruction.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; the work directly addresses online/streaming low-latency 3D reconstruction from videos.

results.title: WinT3R: Window-Based Streaming Reconstruction with Camera Token Pool
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes a feed-forward reconstruction model for online prediction of camera poses and high-quality point maps, using a sliding window mechanism and global camera token pool.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; title and abstract directly match streaming/online point-map reconstruction.

results.title: StreamSplat: Towards Online Dynamic 3D Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Video Streams
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview presents StreamSplat as a fully feed-forward framework that transforms uncalibrated video streams of arbitrary length into dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting representations online under latency and memory constraints.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; source fits the plan's dynamic or online 3D reconstruction from video scope with point/Gaussian-map-like outputs.

results.title: UniSplat: Unified Spatio-Temporal Fusion via 3D Latent Scaffolds for Dynamic Driving Scene Reconstruction
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes a feed-forward dynamic driving-scene reconstruction framework with spatio-temporal fusion, dynamic-aware Gaussians, point-anchored refinement, and persistent static-Gaussian memory for streaming scene completion.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant under dynamic or online Gaussian/point-based mapping and streaming scene completion.

results.title: IncVGGT: Incremental VGGT for Memory-Bounded Long-Range 3D Reconstruction
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview presents IncVGGT as a training-free incremental VGGT variant for memory-bounded long-sequence 3D reconstruction, addressing cache growth and latency in streaming variants through composite views and history-side pruning.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant to incremental/streaming 3D reconstruction and long-range point-cloud reconstruction.

results.title: TTT3R: 3D Reconstruction as Test-Time Training
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview frames 3D reconstruction foundation-model state updates as an online learning problem and reports operation at 20 FPS with 6 GB GPU memory over thousands of images.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant to real-time/online long-sequence 3D reconstruction.

results.title: ARTDECO: Toward High-Fidelity On-the-Fly Reconstruction with Hierarchical Gaussian Structure and Feed-Forward Guidance
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes monocular-video on-the-fly 3D reconstruction, positioned around real-time feed-forward foundation-model inference and structured Gaussian scene representations.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant to on-the-fly real-time 3D reconstruction and Gaussian/point-based mapping.

results.title: $\pi^3$: Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes a feed-forward visual-geometry model that predicts camera poses and scale-invariant local point maps, with reported use for monocular/video depth estimation and dense point-map reconstruction.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant to point-map reconstruction, though the search record is weaker on online or streaming operation.

results.title: Dens3R: A Foundation Model for 3D Geometry Prediction
results.abstract_or_snippet: OpenReview describes a visual foundation model for unified 3D geometry prediction, motivated by consistency among depth, normals, and point maps, with a pointmap representation and geometrically consistent multi-view inference.
results.scope_match_rationale: Official OpenReview record confirms ICLR 2026 Poster status; relevant to point-map and 3D geometry reconstruction, but weaker on online/streaming video operation.
